title: Our Future Health — Genotype array data — Sample QC metrics — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the genotype_sample_qc_metrics table, from plausibility ranges the source does not state (D127). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.

allOf.$comment: Warning G01: call_rate is expected to be between 0 and 1 (the call rate is the proportion of variants with a genotype call); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
